Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

Compatibility and capacity

List affected public APIs, schemas, protocols, backends, execution paths, and capacity. State the migration or write “none.”

Evidence

List exact commands and outcomes. Identify skipped tools, unavailable environments, and claims the evidence does not establish.

Checklist

  • Relevant positive and negative tests were added or updated.
  • Public behavior and [Unreleased] notes were updated where needed.
  • No old record, schema, or protocol is silently uplifted.
  • Generated/AOT source closure was checked when embedded runtime code changed.
  • Claude and Codex are not named as authors, committers, co-authors, signers, or contributors in this change.
  • This change contains no secrets, credentials, bearer capabilities, or publicly disclosed vulnerability details.
